explainer_content.short_definition: The core country songbook: honky-tonk heartbreak, Nashville broadcast polish, and plainspoken vocal authority.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Classic country crystallized through radio, touring, the Opry, and Nashville songcraft, carrying rural and working-class stories into national popular culture.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It built the reference vocabulary that later outlaw, country-pop, red dirt, and Americana lanes either inherit or react against.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The songs are concise, emotionally direct, and built around voice, lyric, fiddle, steel, and rhythm-guitar feel.
